executions.name: 初次Windows连接/服务库存
executions.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ports = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID, Name, PNPDeviceID, Status)
$usb = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -match '^USB\\VID_(0403|10C4|1A86)' } | Select-Object Name, PNPDeviceID, Status)
$procs = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(hw_server|cs_server|xsdb|xsct|vivado|vitis|putty|ttermpro)\.exe$' } | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath, CommandLine)
$listener = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess)
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
[pscustomobject]@{ serial_ports=$ports; relevant_usb=$usb; fpga_processes=$procs; listener_3121=$listener; free_physical_memory_kib=$os.FreePhysicalMemory } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7
